mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, status, total_amount, payable_amount, created_at, CASE status WHEN 0 THEN '待付款' WHEN 1 THEN '待发货' WHEN 2 THEN '待收货' WHEN 3 THEN '已完成' WHEN 4 THEN '已取消' WHEN 5 THEN '已关闭' ELSE '未知状态' END AS status_text FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.status = 3 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product_review pr WHERE pr.order_id = o.id ) ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
SELECT id, title, specs, image, price, quantity, amount FROM order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id ASC
